subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers land this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility slice after conflict resolution while leaving the broader linear workspace accessibility request open?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but the protected maintainer label, user-facing accessibility wording, and partial-overlap relationship with the larger product-direction issue require maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Land the narrow slice
options.body: Merge this focused picker orientation affordance after maintainer review and required checks, without treating it as a full fix for the broader accessibility workflow.

options.title: Hold for broader design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide the larger linear workspace accessibility direction and whether picker ordinals are the desired first step.

options.title: Close as unwanted direction
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers decide split-pane picker numbering is not the product direction, preserving the broader issue for a different design.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Merge this focused picker orientation affordance after maintainer review and required checks, without treating it as a full fix for the broader accessibility workflow.
